Naomi —

Quick notes from Legal & Compliance based on MonetaryTech’s SIG: 

- SOC 2: we can provide our latest SOC 2 Type II and the auditor attestation (will include subservice orgs list). Expect delivery by EOD Wednesday.
- DPA redlines: I’ll prepare Redwood_DPA_v2_redlines.pdf with tracked items we typically defend (data export, breach notifications, liability caps); legal prefers procurement@monetarytech.com for direct exchange.
- Retention: Redwood supports per-tenant retention policies and data-class level windows. Standard supported tiers: 30, 90, 180, 365, and custom retention by contract for dedicated/private customers. Two asks to close fast:

I’ll attach the DPA redlines and a short evidence index by noon.

Thanks Karthik — that helps. A few responses from our side: 

- Data classes: primary will be tokenized payment metadata + anonymized usage telemetry; no unencrypted raw PII expected. I’ll send a short table by EOD.
- SOC 2: please send the report and subservice list; our risk team will verify controls around key management and access reviews.
- Retention: 90 days for telemetry, 365 days for payment metadata is our preference. Need to see confirmation of per-tenant enforcement and whether logs can be scoped to ElasticSearch retention windows.

Procurement: procurement@monetarytech.com will expect tracked redlines to the DPA and a DocuSign-ready copy once legal alignment is done.

We’re good to run Friday 10–10:30 PT for the evidence walkthrough — invite sent to security@monetarytech.com.
